why_this_recipe: LAW025: down_proj:2 is free against a 4-bit base and breaks against a 3-bit one. sens-a is this same allocation on a 3-bit base and fails 5/8. Moving it to the base where its tilt is free was a prediction, and it held.

reference.note: emitting far more audio than bf16 for the same text is garbage, not speed

realtime_factor_was_corrupted_by_the_jam: A jamming rung produces MORE audio per wall second and therefore scores a HIGHER realtime factor. sens_c's headline 15.60x came from emitting 269.9 s for chunks bf16 renders in 120.4 s -- 2.24x the correct length, nearly all of it a constant-rms buzz. sens_e's 9.67x is over 116.0 s of audio that matches the reference text at wer_med 0.0. Throughput on generated media must be normalised to the reference's output length, or the worst model wins the speed comparison.
against_the_handoff: HANDOFF-from-audioresearch.md assumed Higgs v3 4B at 2.03-2.16x realtime unquantized and framed overnight rendering of the 93.1 h library as the open problem. At 9.67x on usable audio the library projects to about 9.6 h, so the speed target was already met and the binding constraint was jam-free output all along.
projection_caveat: 9.67x is measured on 8 chunks of <=60 words rendered as one batch, including model load. It is not a measurement of a 93.1 h run and the projection inherits that.
what_is_NOT_sealed: sens_f, which adds attention at 3 bits on the same 4-bit base, is 6/8 with two 25-30 s silence dropouts. Attention below the base costs more than the MLP tilt does.

widened.why: 0 failures in 8 is consistent with a true failure rate up to 31.2%. For a 93 h render that is not a basis for anything.
widened.run: same arm, n=32, seed 91 instead of 4242, same chunking
widened.failure_rate_95pct_upper_bound: 14.0% from 1 in 32; the point estimate is 3.1%
widened.verdict: the fixed point is gone on the 4-bit base, not merely rarer

operating_protocol.gate: verify.check for silence, dropout, truncation, looping and word error; tools/future/tts_gate.stuck_run for the fixed point the others cannot see
operating_protocol.retry: re-render flagged units with a different seed
operating_protocol.expected_cost: about 8 retries across the 253-unit library at the measured 1-in-32 rate
operating_protocol.note: the gate is what makes this shippable. Without stuck_run a jam-class regression would pass silently, since the jam is neither silent nor transcribable.

still_open: the 1-in-32 silence dropout has no attributed mechanism; it may be seed-specific or systematic
9.45-10.68x is measured on batches of 32 short chunks, not on a 93 h run
